title: 第21章 三才妙严大法杨蛟的未来闻太师来访第22章 后知后觉的瑶姬崩乱的王母
slug: 杨戬你爹从朝歌城考编回来了
content_zh:
;;
金乌大帝覆灭，数千天兵天将被二十四颗定海珠灭杀，杨易将手中的竹杖朝着虚空之中一点，二十四颗定海珠与那竹杖顷刻间消失在了原地。
关于赵公明，此事还要从当年与闻仲南征说起，路过那峨眉山的时候，闻仲提起要去拜会一下他的师叔赵公明。
自从拜入截教之后，闻仲得到了赵公明不少照拂，所以闻仲与赵公明的关系很好。
闻仲将杨易引荐给了赵公明，赵公明起初对于杨易这么一个凡人并不在意，但还是以礼相待。
闻仲久在朝堂，对自己的修炼有一些困惑，于是便询问赵公明，杨易恰到好处的提了这么一嘴。
就是这么一嘴，却惹上了赵公明这个话痨。
赵公明彻底打开了话匣子，与杨易在峨眉山上论道了七天七夜。
杨易跟赵公明说了这二十四颗定海珠如何炼成二十四诸天，只不过这二十四诸天并不是佛道的二十四诸天，而是以天地大道演化。
赵公明听得那叫一个如痴如醉，为了给杨易提神醒脑，不惜耗费大法力，甚至将他珍藏多年的上品灵根都拿了出来。
两人也因此成了忘年之交，以至于后来编撰“天地玄黄”这一本易书，赵公明都出了不少力。
太学院立天下文道之首，便是以这本易书为根基，而这本易书引动了天地大运，杨易为了隐藏天机，让赵公明与孔宣二人联手镇压天象。
杨易身上的大部分文道气运，就是这么得来的。
而且这本易书之中阐述了不少上清遁去之一的道理，赵公明告诉杨易，自立下了这本易书之后，他截教法脉因此欠下了杨易大因果。
至于截教得了多少好处，赵公明不知道，杨易不知道，只有通天教主知道。
听到杨易招惹上了天庭，这赵公明毫不犹豫的说要出手相助。
架不住赵公明的热情，杨易便要了这二十四颗定海珠防身，只不过这杀业算在杨易身上，并不是在赵公明身上。
孔宣百无聊赖的摇了摇头，道：“这极品先天灵宝定海珠落在赵公明手中还真是浪费，他参悟这二十四诸天，如今也只是见了皮毛而已。”
“本以为这金乌大帝是何等强大，想不到只是一只小小渡鸦。”
杨易淡然一笑，道：“这等大道参悟需要一定的机缘，可能只是时机未到罢了。”

“玉虚十二金仙之一的玉鼎真人寻找到了二郎，说要收他为徒，成为他替劫棋子，你看以如今婵儿的法力可否应付这玉鼎真人。”
孔宣犹豫了一下，道：“婵儿如今只是天仙道行，天凤真羽里面的凤凰之力还没有完全炼化，可若是以仁善之力催动宝莲灯，就算玉鼎真人也伤不了她分毫。待我略施手段，定然让婵儿将那玉鼎真人打得满地找牙。”
杨易无可奈何的笑出声来，没办法，之所以这么设计，第一是想让杨戬知道这天地险恶，第二是告诉杨戬，他要想修道，他老子有的是手段。
有时候教孩子就是这样，不能一蹴而就，凡事也需要讲究一个循序渐进，尤其是杨戬这种天生反骨。
刚才杨易以二十四颗定海珠施展出了太虚幻境，就是不想让这些天兵天将乱了杨家村的平静生活。
此刻太虚幻境已经散去，孔宣却一脸凝重的朝着天上看了一眼。
“老爷，夫人与那太白金星已上天庭去了。”
听到孔宣这么一说，杨易脚步微微一颤，这瑶姬终究还是没有将他的话听进去，选择一个人直面这一切。
然而杨易却比想象当中的要安定，杨易点了点头，道：“就让瑶儿先去天庭走一步吧，反正我也打算不日之后上天庭一趟。”
回到了房间，杨易便看到了瑶姬留下的信笺。
上面瑶姬坦露了自己的身份，而且还告诉杨易，等她平了天庭的事，自然会下界来找他。
字里行间，情深义重，能看出瑶姬的不舍与无奈。
杨易叹了一口气，道：“瑶儿，天庭那昊天靠不住，只有为夫才是你最大的靠山。”
杨易急忙修书一封，吩咐杨蛟将这书信送到魔礼青手中。
到了晚上。
杨易一个人靠在书房里面发呆，昏暗的油灯下，杨易想起了自己的娇妻瑶姬，不由得一阵伤感。
在瑶姬看来，自己就算成了当朝太傅，可也管不到天庭的事，金乌大帝下界征伐，被太虚幻境封锁了天机，瑶姬也察觉不到。
一想到瑶姬或许要上天庭受苦，杨易就一阵心疼。
十年考编，经历了多少风风雨雨，他直面过这天地间顶尖的大能，与他们博弈周旋，早已经将这局面布置得密不透风。
杨易的心思也早已经凌厉到了极致，可唯有自己这家人才是自己的软肋。

The Golden Crow Emperor was destroyed, and thousands of heavenly soldiers and generals were killed by twenty-four Dinghai Pearls. Yang Yi pointed the bamboo stick in his hand toward the void, and the twenty-four Dinghai Pearls and the bamboo stick disappeared in an instant.
As for Zhao Gongming, this matter started with Wen Zhong Nanzheng. When passing by Mount Emei, Wen Zhong mentioned that he wanted to pay a visit to his uncle Zhao Gongming.
Since joining Jiejiao, Wen Zhong has received a lot of care from Zhao Gongming, so the relationship between Wen Zhong and Zhao Gongming is very good.
Wen Zhong introduced Yang Yi to Zhao Gongming. Zhao Gongming didn't care about Yang Yi at first, but he still treated him with courtesy.
Wen Zhongjiu was in the court and was a little confused about his cultivation, so he asked Zhao Gongming, and Yang Yi mentioned it just right.
Just such a talk got him into trouble with the talkative Zhao Gongming.
Zhao Gongming completely opened up his chatterbox and discussed Taoism with Yang Yi on Mount Emei for seven days and nights.
Yang Yi told Zhao Gongming how these twenty-four Dinghai Pearls were refined into the twenty-four heavens. However, these twenty-four heavens were not the twenty-four heavens of Buddhism, but evolved from the great road of heaven and earth.
Zhao Gongming was so mesmerized when he heard that cry that he did not hesitate to spend a lot of mana to refresh Yang Yi, even taking out all the high-grade spiritual roots that he had treasured for many years.
As a result, the two became close friends, so much so that Zhao Gongming contributed a lot to the compilation of the Book of Changes "Heaven and Earth Xuanhuang".
Taiyuan University established itself as the leader in the world's literary arts, based on this Book of Changes, and this Book of Changes triggered the great fortune of heaven and earth. In order to hide the secrets of heaven and earth, Yang Yi asked Zhao Gongming and Kong Xuan to join forces to suppress the celestial phenomena.
This is how Yang Yi got most of his literary luck.
Moreover, this Book of Changes expounded many principles of escape from the Qing Dynasty. Zhao Gongming told Yang Yi that since he established this Book of Changes, he had cut off the teachings and owed Yang Yi a great cause and effect.
As for how much benefit Jiejiao has gained, Zhao Gongming doesn't know, Yang Yi doesn't know, only the leader of Tongtian Cult knows.
Hearing that Yang Yi had provoked Heaven, Zhao Gongming said without hesitation that he would help.
Unable to resist Zhao Gongming's enthusiasm, Yang Yi asked for these twenty-four Dinghai Pearls to defend himself. However, the murderous karma was attributed to Yang Yi, not Zhao Gongming.
Kong Xuan shook his head in boredom and said: "It is really a waste that this top-quality innate spiritual treasure Dinghai Pearl fell into Zhao Gongming's hands. He has only scratched the surface of the twenty-four heavens."
"I thought this Golden Crow Emperor was so powerful, but I didn't expect it was just a little raven."
Yang Yi smiled calmly and said: "This kind of enlightenment requires a certain amount of opportunity, maybe it's just that the time has not come yet."
"Master Yuding, one of the Twelve Golden Immortals of Yuxu, has found Erlang and said that he will accept him as his disciple and become his chess piece for the robbery. Let's see if Chan'er's current magic power can deal with this Master Yuding."
Kong Xuan hesitated for a moment and said: "Chan'er is just an immortal Taoist now, and the power of the phoenix in Tianfeng Zhenyu has not been fully refined, but if the treasure lotus lantern is activated with the power of kindness, even Master Yuding cannot hurt her at all. When I use some tricks, Chan'er will definitely beat Master Yuding to the ground with teeth."
Yang Yi laughed helplessly. He had no choice. The reason for this design was firstly to let Yang Jian know that this world is dangerous, and secondly to tell Yang Jian that if he wants to practice Taoism, he has many means.
Sometimes teaching children is just like this. It cannot be accomplished overnight. Everything needs to be done step by step, especially for Yang Jian, who is naturally rebellious.
Just now, Yang Yi used twenty-four Dinghai Pearls to display Taixu Illusion, just because he didn't want these heavenly soldiers and generals to disrupt the peaceful life of Yangjia Village.
At this moment, the illusion of Taixu had dissipated, but Kong Xuan glanced at the sky with a solemn expression.
"Sir, my wife and the Taibaijinxing have gone to heaven."
Hearing what Kong Xuan said, Yang Yi's steps trembled slightly. After all, Yao JiStill didn't listen to his words and chose to face it all alone.
However, Yang Yi was more stable than expected. Yang Yi nodded and said, "Let Yao'er go to heaven first. Anyway, I plan to go to heaven in the future."
After returning to the room, Yang Yi saw the letter left by Yao Ji.
Yao Ji revealed her identity above, and also told Yang Yi that when she settles the matter in heaven, she will naturally come to the lower world to find him.
Between the lines, there is deep love and deep meaning, and one can see Yao Ji's reluctance and helplessness.
Yang Yi sighed and said: "Yao'er, Haotian in Heaven is unreliable. Only your husband is your biggest supporter."
Yang Yi hurriedly wrote a letter and ordered Yang Jiao to deliver the letter to Mo Liqing.
At night.
Yang Yi was leaning alone in the study in a daze. Under the dim oil lamp, Yang Yi thought of his beloved wife Yao Ji and couldn't help but feel sad.
From Yao Ji's point of view, even if she became the Grand Tutor of the dynasty, she would not be able to take care of the affairs of the Heavenly Court. The Golden Crow Emperor's expedition to the lower realms had blocked the heavenly secrets by the Taixu Illusion Realm, and Yao Ji could not notice it.
Yang Yi felt heartbroken when he thought that Yao Ji might have to go to heaven to suffer.
After ten years of examination and experience, he has experienced many ups and downs. He has faced the top powers in the world and dealt with them. He has already arranged this situation to be airtight.
Yang Yi's thoughts have already reached the extreme level, but his family is his only weakness.
